page.overview:
What is Walrus School?

The Walrus School is an elementary school and the main educational institution of Elbaph, hosted in the Warrior's Spring alongside the neighboring Owl Library and southwest of Western Village. Giant children between the ages of 18–36 (6–12 in human years) attend the school in order to learn about different subjects and socialize with other children.

It was founded 20 years ago by Jaguar D. Saul under the request of the late King of Elbaph, Harald.

The Walrus School is an immense structure built on Branch Route 8, which rises from the Warrior's Spring coast and has boardwalk stairs built along its body so people can access the main building. The Owl Library is located just next to it, on an adjacent branch.

The school overall resembles an open treehouse, with two large central platforms (where most of the school's facilities are located) surrounded by several smaller structures, which are held aloft by hanging ropes tied to other parts of the branch. Some of those structures resemble playground swings while others spherical huts.
